_readme: EXAMPLE circuits for a generic flat. It is NOT anyone's real home and NOT a real tariff.
Copy this file to data/app/circuits.json (JARVIS_DATA_DIR) and edit it there: that copy is
git-ignored and never committed. Rated watts come from each appliance's label; the relay
channel is the relay that carries the circuit (null = tracked only, never switched).
JARVIS refuses, in code, to put an AC, geyser or heater on a relay, and anything drawing
more than 5.6 A (80% of a 7 A relay's rating) - whatever this file says.

circuits.name: Night lamp
circuits.note: left on for whoever walks to the bathroom at night

circuits.name: Bedroom ceiling fan
circuits.note: example step watts for a 1200 mm fan on a capacitor regulator - measure yours

circuits.name: Bedroom AC (1.5 ton)
circuits.note: label input power; an inverter AC averages well below it. IR control is planned, never a relay

circuits.name: Bathroom geyser (15 L)
circuits.note: tracked when you say it is on; JARVIS reminds you, he never switches it

tariff.name: EXAMPLE slabs - replace with your DISCOM's domestic tariff
tariff.note: energy charge only: fixed charges, electricity duty and taxes are not included. base_kwh_month is the rest of the house's monthly units from your bill, so these circuits are priced at the slab they really fall in
